title: Certificates of Deposit: grace add-ons and an interest payout that names a closed account
content:
## Scope

This rule applies to a Certificates of Deposit certificate in its grace period when new money is to be added, including a top-up to reach the jumbo bonus on renewal. It ties the acceptance of grace add-ons to the state of the account that receives the certificate's interest.

## Condition before new grace money is added

The certificate's payout disposition names an open account of the owner before new grace money is added. New money added during grace becomes principal on which the renewed term's interest is credited and paid out, which is why the account receiving that interest must be open.

## Rule

1. **Grace add-ons.** A grace add-on, in single deposits of at least the tier's smallest grace add-on and in total within the tier's most added per grace period, is accepted on a tier that allows grace add-ons only while the certificate's interest disposition names no closed payout account.
2. **How it is read.** Whether the disposition names a closed payout account is read from the status of the account named as payout account: the checking account for pay to checking, and the savings account for pay to savings. A disposition of compound names no payout account.
3. **Top-up.** While the disposition pays to a closed payout account, no top-up is written.

## Condition table

| Interest disposition | Status of the named payout account | Grace add-on or top-up can be accepted? |
|---|---|---|
| Compound | Not concerned, no payout account is named | Yes, as far as this rule goes |
| Pay to checking | Checking account active | Yes, as far as this rule goes |
| Pay to checking | Checking account closed | No |
| Pay to savings | Savings account active | Yes, as far as this rule goes |
| Pay to savings | Savings account closed | No |

## Points of judgement

**The owner wants to add money during grace, and the certificate's interest is still being paid to a savings account that the owner closed last month. Can the add-on be taken as things stand?**
No. While the disposition pays to a closed payout account, no grace add-on is accepted and no top-up is written.

**The certificate compounds its interest. Does this rule stand in the way?**
No. A disposition of compound names no payout account.
